INSERT INTO IRDNT_INFO (RECIPE_ID, IRDNT_SN, IRDNT_NM, IRDNT_CPCTY, IRDNT_TY_CODE, IRDNT_TY_NM) VALUES
(#{item.recipeId}, #{item.irdntSn}, #{item.irdntNm}, #{item.irdntCpcty}, #{item.irdntTyCode}, #{item.irdntTyNm})
mapper.select:
SELECT r.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, r.RECIPE_NM_KO AS recipeNmKo, r.SUMRY AS sumry, r.NATION_CODE AS nationCode, r.NATION_NM AS nationNm, r.TY_CODE AS tyCode, r.TY_NM AS tyNm, r.COOKING_TIME AS cookingTime, r.CALORIE AS calorie, r.QNT AS qnt, r.LEVEL_NM AS levelNm, r.HIT AS hit, r.LIKE_COUNT AS likeCount, r.PRICE AS price, r.WRITER_ID AS writerId, m.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, m.PROFILE_IMG AS writerProfileImg, (SELECT img_url FROM recipe_image WHERE recipe_code = r.RECIPE_ID ORDER BY sort_order ASC LIMIT 1) AS thumbImgUrl
FROM RECIPE r LEFT JOIN member m ON r.WRITER_ID = m.ID
JOIN RECIPE_TAG rt ON r.recipe_id = rt.recipe_id
JOIN IRDNT_INFO ii ON r.recipe_id = ii.recipe_id
AND r.recipe_nm_ko LIKE CONCAT('%', #{recipeNmKo}, '%')
AND rt.tag_id IN
#{tid}
AND r.level_nm = #{levelNm}
AND ii.irdnt_nm IN
#{nm}
AND r.WRITER_ID IS NOT NULL AND r.WRITER_ID != '' AND m.BIRTH_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.BIRTH_DATE, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 20 AND 39
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.BIRTH_DATE, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 40 AND 59
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, m.BIRTH_DATE, CURDATE()) >= 60
GROUP BY r.RECIPE_ID
ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.RECIPE_ID DESC
ORDER BY r.LIKE_COUNT DESC
ORDER BY r.HIT DESC
ORDER BY ( r.LIKE_COUNT + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW rv WHERE rv.RECIPE_CODE = r.RECIPE_ID AND rv.THUMBS_UP = 1 ) ) DESC
ORDER BY r.recipe_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DISTINCT
FROM RECIPE r LEFT JOIN member m ON r.WRITER_ID = m.ID WHERE r.writer_id = #{writerId} ORDER BY r.recipe_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECIPE ( RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_NM_KO, SUMRY, NATION_CODE, NATION_NM, TY_CODE, TY_NM, COOKING_TIME, CALORIE, QNT, LEVEL_NM, HIT, LIKE_COUNT, PRICE, WRITER_ID ) VALUES ( #{recipeCode}, #{recipeInfo.recipeNmKo}, #{recipeInfo.sumry}, #{recipeInfo.nationCode}, #{recipeInfo.nationNm}, #{recipeInfo.tyCode}, #{recipeInfo.tyNm}, #{recipeInfo.cookingTime}, #{recipeInfo.calorie}, #{recipeInfo.qnt}, #{recipeInfo.levelNm}, 0, 0, #{price}, #{writerId} )

INSERT INTO COOKING_INFO (RECIPE_ID, COOKING_NO, COOKING_DC, STEP_TIP, STEP_IMG_URL, IMG_TYPE) VALUES
